Inside the method

What counts as pressure?

Before the ball

Wickets, time left and match stakes shape separate batting and bowling scores. Crunch begins at 60. Squeeze begins at 50 and gives bowlers a larger sample.

IPL batting events reaching Crunch

[MEASURED] scope.csv

Against matched peers

Compare runs and wickets with expectations for the role, phase and match context. Each wicket carries six runs of value. Report the total per six pressure balls.

Why rank by floor?

The floor is the 20th percentile of estimated impact. Four in five model estimates sit above it. Players need 24 weighted legal balls across at least four matches.

How well did it repeat?

Batting impact had a split-half correlation of 0.39 (interval 0.03 to 0.67). Bowling showed little repeatability. Batting bad-night rates had a split-half correlation of −0.36 (interval −0.65 to 0.11). Only 67 of 500 splits had enough data. The early-to-late bad-night check had six common players and needed ten. The held-out backtest was inconclusive.
